sources.name: ClinVar C>T record
sources.supports: TCF7L2 transcript HGVS and ClinVar Variation ID for the C>T allele.

sources.name: ClinVar C>G record
sources.supports: The distinct alternate allele returned by the same rsID search.

sources.name: Ensembl variation
sources.supports: rsID identity, dbSNP source, and returned cross-reference synonyms.

sources.name: UKB-TOPMed PheWAS
sources.supports: GRCh38 allele identity, nearest gene, allele frequency, and association-count metadata.

sources.name: gnomAD r4 C>T record
sources.supports: Allele-resolved genome AC, AN, and AF returned by the verified GraphQL request.

method_note: The case is allele-specific. The C>T and C>G ClinVar records are never merged. The UKB-TOPMed request uses the explicit GRCh38 C>T allele because an rsID-only resolution selected C>G.
